SlopCut · Beta

SlopCut: video editor

A video editor that never uploads your footage.

Open now

SlopCut has these main features: Multi-track timeline; Trim, split, transitions & titles. It opens Video, Audio, Any image.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.
